@context._comment: Nekazari Platform NGSI-LD @context — canonical namespace mappings. Types prefixed 'nkz:' are platform extensions (no SDM/SAREF4AGRI equivalent per FIWARE Smart Data Models catalog audit 2026-05-03). Types prefixed 'saref4agri:' are legacy — retained for backward compatibility with existing Orion-LD entities; new entities SHOULD use 'nkz:' variants.

AgriculturalRobot._comment: Platform extension — no equivalent in SAREF4AGRI or any SDM catalog. Alias: AgriRobot (robotics module) maps to same nkz:AgriculturalRobot URI. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalRobot.

AgriSensor._comment: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no AgriSensor class (only specific sensor types like Pluviometer, Thermometer). Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriSensor.

AgriParcel._comment: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI uses s4agri:Parcel, not AgriParcel. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriParcel.

AgriOperation._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriOperation.

AgriculturalTractor._comment: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural tractors. Closest: ManufacturingMachine. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalTractor.

AgriculturalImplement._comment: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural implements. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalImplement.

AgriEquipment._comment: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for generic agricultural equipment. Used as parent type for tractors and implements.

AgriParcelOperation._comment: Platform extension — SDM AgriParcelOperation lacks agricultural machinery kinematics properties. Platform extends with A-B lines and VRA fields.

AgriCropObservation._comment: Platform extension of SDM AgriCrop (which lacks observation/image capture semantics).

WeatherObserved._comment: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no WeatherObserved. SDM WeatherObserved exists in dataModel.Weather. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:WeatherObserved.

SatelliteImageObservation._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:SatelliteImageObservation.

VegetationIndex._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:VegetationIndex.

LivestockAnimal._comment: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no LivestockAnimal class. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockAnimal.

LivestockGroup._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockGroup.

LivestockFarm._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockFarm.

LivestockProduction._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockProduction.

PhotovoltaicInstallation._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:PhotovoltaicInstallation.

EnergyStorageSystem._comment: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:EnergyStorageSystem.

CropHealthAssessment._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Crop health evaluation result from epidemiological models.

DiseaseRiskAssessment._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Daily disease risk evaluation per parcel.

RiskAssessment._comment: Platform extension — generic risk evaluation result for batch-evaluated risks (robotic, energy, livestock, agronomic). Disease-specific risks use DiseaseRiskAssessment.

DeviceCommand._comment: Platform extension — MQTT device command tracking. Records command lifecycle (pending -> sent/failed) for IoT device management.

CarbonStock._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Soil organic carbon stock assessment per parcel.

DigitalAsset._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. LiDAR point cloud and 3D model assets.

AgriEnergyTracker._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy production/consumption tracking for agricultural installations.

EnergyMeter._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy metering device for Odoo ERP integration.

AgriDevice._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Legacy device type used by DaTaK setup scripts. Prefer AgriSensor for new entities.

AgriculturalMachine._comment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Generic agricultural machinery parent type for tractors and implements.

AgriRobot._comment: Alias for AgriculturalRobot — both resolve to nkz:AgriculturalRobot. Robotics module uses AgriRobot as entity type. Standardized 2026-05-08.

AgriSoilExtended._comment: SDM-001 Proposal: Extension of AgriSoil with soil horizon data and pedotransfer function properties (LUCAS/SoilGrids integration)

SoilSamplingPoint._comment: SDM-002 Proposal: Point sample location with laboratory analysis results and spatial reference

SoilSurvey._comment: SDM-003 Proposal: Survey campaign metadata (instrumentation, point count, spatial coverage)

SoilDerivedRaster._comment: SDM-004 Proposal: Raster derived from point samples or gridded soil models (COG/NetCDF storage)
